scope_statement: User-discovered Wilder trace-recovery, mapping, and common-grid defects in Insertion Loss Tool.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Pale crossings can exchange identity; gray, dashed, or unlabelled traces can disappear; raw source counts can be confused with the output grid; crowded plots can return plausible but unproved fragments.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The old extractor relied on chroma and local continuity, treated label evidence too strongly, did not expose source coverage separately from the calibrated grid, and lacked a fail-closed joint-association limit.
